items.description: S3 Arctic platform with EO/IR gimbal, 120km range capability

notes: NextTech Solutions (DoD integrator) evaluating S3 Arctic for tactical deployment. Requires 120km range (1h 35min TOF) with EO/IR gimbal. Demo schedule: Ottawa flight test June-Aug 2026, vendor meet-and-greet, Arctic demo Whitehorse Nov-Apr 2027 to validate for Joint Forces Command purchases. Early-stage evaluation; customer does not expect 100% solution yet.
